column1: # mapping_set_description: Alignments from the gist upper ontology (Semantic Arts) to the Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) as rendered in LinkML by lmodel/dpv, grounding DPV entities, agreements, contracts, rules, intellectual property and locations in gist.

column7: A data processing agreement is one kind of agreement
A data subject is a person whose personal data is processed
DPV Contract is the legal basis of performing a contract, not the contract itself
DPV IntellectualPropertyData is data protected by intellectual property rights
DPV LegalEntity is any human or non-human entity recognised in law, so it is broader than gist Organization
DPV defines a natural person as a human
DPV Obligation is any obligation to perform an activity; a contingent obligation is a narrower kind
DPV OrganisationalUnit is a unit within an organisation that is not a separate legal entity
Both describe what one is permitted to do
DPV StorageLocation is a location in the role of storing data
DPV ThirdParty is a natural or legal person in the role of a third party
